records.title: The effects of pressure breathing on decompression sickness and circulatory reaction in cadets
records.locator: Method and Results, scans 3–8, and Tables I–VII, scans 10–16
records.note: The experiments were conducted among San Antonio Aviation Cadet Center students. The 38,000-ft tables include repeat flights and selected previously trained and untrained groups. The 45,000-ft comparison is held for overlap with Project 252. The ground-level denominator varies within the report.
